about: The flow suite of wltest check on windmill-lite (ADR 0011, milestone E1 of ADR 0012): the flow fixtures' runs that must pass in warm mode, which TestFlowSuite checks. A run is required when runs lists it, with the milestone whose pull request first made it pass, or when a recording batch's manifest (internal/oracle/testdata/batches/<batch>.json) gates it on a milestone listed in implemented. A required run stays required: a later engine must keep passing it. runs is not a batch's gates, which name the milestone whose exit gate must make a run pass; a run may pass earlier, as the E3b and E3c runs below do on W1's walking skeleton. Every other run is still run, reported, and must not fail to load.
